configurations.energy_boundary_note: Vehicle-battery draw is battery-terminal energy including vehicle-to-UAV converter losses. External site energy is a separate site-meter boundary. No pod mass, charging hardware, electrical load, thermal or fire data have been qualified.
notes: Require pod/aircraft as-built mass and mounting interface.
Require phase/duty-cycle battery-terminal energy and HV-bus power.
Require independent site-meter energy and time-resolved coincident peak data.
Require qualified cargo, retention, axle/CG, thermal/fire, EMC and service evidence.

configurations.energy_boundary_note: Trailer, aircraft and site energy are separate from the tractor battery. This configuration must be compared with the published TSP-MDST trailer architecture on matched missions.
notes: Require trailer gross/axle/coupling/braking and stability envelope.
Require trailer battery/charger/site meter and aircraft service data.
Do not claim novelty from mobile trailer deployment alone.
